lines: bringing swiss banking energy to note taking
your notes are encrypted on your device
the server stores ciphertext. it finds it dull
data miners found nothing but sadness
no ads. no trackers. no plot twist
open source, so you can check the math
making your notes boring to strangers
your diary called. it wants privacy
your journal kept your secrets overnight
one private place for everything you’d never post
no algorithm decides what you see here
your brain dump is safe and sound
writing is thinking. thinking is private
loadingOnly: one moment while we disappoint advertisers
counting your unchecked tasks. no judgment
no ads were shown during this loading
putting your notes back where you left them
shuffling bits into a nice order
remembering what you forgot to remember
